habitat: Wikipedia says it breeds in Europe and temperate western Asia and winters in tropical Africa, Arabia and Pakistan. Newman has no species page, so no Kruger habitat is stored from that account.
summary: Newman has no species page. Wikipedia describes a migratory warbler, brown above and buff below, with chestnut fringes to the secondaries. The male has a grey head and a white throat. The female lacks the grey head and has a duller throat. The song is fast and scratchy, and the call is wed-wed or woid-woid. The size is not given. Months are unset. No Kemp estimate is stored.

calls.description: The song is fast and scratchy. The call is hoarse and slightly nasal, 'wed-wed' or 'woid-woid'. The warning is a long rough 'tschehr'. No recording from South Africa was found. The selected file is a grade A call from France. The filename is XC931937-Fauvette-grisette-cris-+++.mp3.
